meta.title: GearUp — Find compatible parts for your machine
meta.description: Enter brand and model to instantly discover which fuel and parts are compatible with your machine.

hero.eyebrow: Never search for the right parts again
hero.scope: Every tool for indoors and out, electric or petrol
hero.recognise: Looking for which fuel, spark plug or filter fits your machine? Enter the brand and model — you'll see it instantly.
hero.hint: Just type what you have, e.g. “Honda HRG 416” or “Stihl MS 250”.

why.independent_d: We don't sell anything ourselves and take no sides.
why.oneclick_d: Checked at model level — no guesswork.
why.nosearch_d: Enter brand and model, and you'll see what fits.

categories.title: Which machine are you looking for?
categories.subtitle: Pick a type to browse brands and models

suggestions.lead: Don't know the model number? Click the card that looks like your machine. Otherwise the model number is on a sticker or type plate on the machine.
suggestions.merk_multi: You haven't picked a type. {merk} makes several kinds of machines — below you'll see all models.
suggestions.pick_model: Pick the brand and model of your machine below.
suggestions.pick_for_part: Pick your brand and model — then you'll see the {part} advice right away.

empty.title: Your search returned no results
empty.lead: Check the spelling — or what you're looking for may not be in our database yet.
empty.noted: We've noted your search. The more often something is searched, the sooner we add it.

result.more_gear_title: Looking for more gear for your {model}?
result.more_gear_sub: Open a part for the advice and the three best buying options.
result.overview_sub: Open a part for the advice and the three best buying options.
result.coming_soon_desc: This product will be added soon.
result.manual_note: For the exact procedure, consult your machine's manual.
result.manual_description: Find the official manual for your machine.
result.disclaimer: GearUp is independent. We don't sell anything ourselves — we show you where to buy the right part. Through the links we earn a small commission; the price doesn't change for you. Advice checked at model level.

notfound.title: This page does not exist
notfound.lead: The link may be outdated or mistyped. Search for your machine again from the home page.

machine.fourmix: this four-stroke runs on mixed fuel (petrol with two-stroke oil), not on pure petrol with separate engine oil.
machine.other_versions: There are more versions of the {model}.
machine.check_plate: Check the rating plate on your machine to see which one you have.
machine.parts_sub: For each part you see the number to buy it by and the source it comes from.
machine.parts_none: There are no parts in GearUp for this machine yet.
machine.parts_not_verified_count: {count, plural, one {One part has} other {# parts have}} not been verified yet.
machine.not_verified: This part has not been verified yet.
machine.manual_lead: Everything about maintenance is in the maker's manual:
machine.disclaimer: GearUp is independent and sells nothing itself. Every part comes from a maker's source; anything not yet verified is marked.
machine.standaard: Fitted as standard on this machine
machine.choices_lead: There are several types. Each type has its own buying options.
machine.maten_letop: this model takes bars of {maten}. The chain belongs to the bar, not to the saw. Always buy on three things: pitch, gauge and number of drive links. The number of drive links alone is not enough. Pick the length of your bar below.
machine.maten_letop_kort: the chain belongs to the bar, not to the saw. Always buy on three things: pitch, gauge and number of drive links. The number of drive links alone is not enough.
machine.diktes_letop: There are also two gauges ({diktes}); check which one your bar has.

housead.tip_plate_text: The model number is on the rating plate: a sticker or plate on the machine. It tells you which version you have.
housead.tip_manual_text: For many parts you see which page of the manual explains how to replace it.
housead.advertise_text: Visitors see your ad here at the moment they are looking for a part for their own machine.

soorten.duro3: Heavy work, stays sharp up to ten times longer

zk.standaard_vraag: Has the bar on your saw never been replaced? Then it came with one of these:
zk.andere: Other bars and chains also fit your model. Do you have a different bar, or want a different chain? Then pick the length and gauge of your bar.
zk.andere_zonder_standaard: Several bars and chains fit your model. Pick the length and gauge of your bar.
zk.waar_staat: Length and gauge are usually stamped on the back of the bar, on the engine side.
zk.geen_ketting: No chain for this size in GearUp yet.
zk.geen_zwaard: No bar for this size in GearUp yet.

bs.kant_uitleg: Petrol and oil are already mixed. You pour it straight into the tank.
bs.meng_uitleg: You mix regular petrol with two-stroke oil, for example in a can or a mixing bottle.
bs.benzine_e10_ja: regular unleaded from the pump. E10 is fine.
bs.benzine_e10_nee: unleaded without E10, for example super unleaded (E5). No E10.
bs.benzine_e10_onbekend: regular unleaded from the pump. The manual does not say whether E10 is allowed.
bs.olie: Oil, how much per litre of petrol:
bs.olie_stihl_of_jaso: with STIHL two-stroke oil or oil marked JASO FB, FC or FD
bs.olie_ander_merk: with two-stroke oil of another brand
bs.olie_let_op: The amount depends on which oil you buy. Check which rule goes with the oil you pick.
